text:
maria (sec): heads-up — noticed slow erase propagation for EU tenant `eu-42`. monitor shows many items still queued after 3 hours. any idea?
jonathan (prod-eng): saw that morning. erasure-worker logs show repeated KMS decrypt retries + cache misses.
kevin (infra-bot): :rotating_light: Alert: `erasure-queue-length` for eu-42 > 500 for 3h. PagerDuty incident created.
sasha (legal): is this a DSAR case or a platform outage? we need timeline + assurance we won't return deleted data. :eyes:
maria (sec): it's an active subject erasure request being processed. priority high. preserving audit trail.
jonathan (prod-eng): quick dump from worker logs: ```
2026-03-21T10:12:03Z erasure-worker[pid=7]: decrypt attempt failed: KMS::ThrottlingException
2026-03-21T10:12:04Z erasure-worker[pid=7]: cache miss for key: projects/eu-keys/key-ring/kr-01/cmk-abc123
2026-03-21T10:12:05Z erasure-worker[pid=7]: retrying decrypt (attempt 3)
```
jonathan (prod-eng): also saw stacktrace when we forced a reconcile: ```
java.lang.RuntimeException: Failed to fetch object metadata	at com.redwood.erasure.s3.S3Client.getMetadata(S3Client.java:112)
Caused by: com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.AmazonS3Exception: Access Denied (Service: AmazonS3; Status Code: 403)
```
maria (sec): 403 from S3? did we change RBAC recently on the erasure service account?
jonathan (prod-eng): yes — infra rolled an RBAC tweak yesterday to tighten s3 permissions for erasure pods. looks like `s3:GetObject` was inadvertently removed for the reconcile role. that made workers hit fallback path that does extra KMS decrypts for tombstones (hence rate).
sasha (legal): ok. two asks: 1) we need a signed timeline and exported logs for the dsar requester (what was attempted, when), 2) confirm no data was restored to user-facing index during the outage.
maria (sec): for timeline we will preserve worker logs + KMS audit logs + S3 access logs. jonathan can you snapshot and upload to evidence bucket (locked) and mark chain-of-custody?
jonathan (prod-eng): doing now. command I'm running: `kubectl exec -n prod erasure-worker-44 -- /app/bin/dump-logs --since 3h | gsutil cp - gs://evidence-lock/eu-42/4401239999/logs.tar.gz`
kevin (infra-bot): Note: KMS audit logs for project `eu-keys` are in CL audit sink `projects/redwood-audit-eu`. Retention policy: 90 days.
maria (sec): for short-term mitigations — can we re-add `s3:GetObject` for reconcile role and throttle erasure worker concurrency to avoid KMS bursts?
jonathan (prod-eng): yes. plan: 1) reapply s3:GetObject to role `erasure-reconcile-role` (will push in 5m), 2) add concurrency cap: `ERASURE_WORKER_PAR=4` via configmap, 3) requeue failed tasks with `--force-reconcile`. That should reduce KMS pressure and let queued deletes finish.
sasha (legal): please confirm before making changes that the tweak won't increase risk of accidental data exposure. we need a quick risk note.
maria (sec): risk: small increase in read surface for reconcile role but limited to metadata objects and only for reconcile job pods (isolated SA). mitigation: short-lived rollback window and audit alerts on any `s3:GetObject` outside reconcile pods.
jonathan (prod-eng): rolling the change now. I'll post back when job finishes and queue drops. :hammer_and_wrench: 
kevin (infra-bot): Deploy in progress: `iam-policy apply erasure-reconcile-role` by jonathan.
maria (sec): after this, we should add an e2e check in our deployment pipeline to validate erasure SA has exact perms needed (test coverage gap). filing a follow-up ticket.
jonathan (prod-eng): update: policy applied, concurrency set to 4, started forced reconcile. queue length down from 520 -> 120 in 12m.
sasha (legal): thanks. please capture the final audit export and send to legal-evidence@redwood.com. also prepare a short blameless summary for the DSAR response.
maria (sec): confirmed — artifacts uploaded, tagging preserved. will draft timeline + root cause for legal.
jonathan (prod-eng): postmortem note: root cause = overly aggressive RBAC tighten removed `s3:GetObject` for reconcile SA -> fallback code caused extra KMS decrypts -> KMS throttling -> erasure queue backlog. action items: infra policy tests, erasure worker rate-limit, alert for KMS throttle spikes.
maria (sec): closing loop here. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
kevin (infra-bot): Incident closed by jonathan at 4401240300.
